name: [UPD] Marble DUELS 🔮
description:
Marble DUELS! Flick your marble, knock marbles out of the ring and keep every one you capture. 1v1 PvP or vs bots!

✨ NEW: every Marble Bag mints a ONE-OF-A-KIND marble. Its own pattern, colours, wear and pattern number. 1.8% hold a PHENOMENON inside: an aurora, a fire, a storm or a black hole!

⚔️ 1v1 DUELS against players on your server
🤖 Play vs bots: 8 levels from Rookie to Legend
🗺️ 7 fields with generated maps, easy to hard: desk, street, lawn, beach, frozen lake, gravel pit and a MINI-GOLF course with cups and bumpers
🏰 THE TOWER: 8 floors, then the Black Taw boss
🌀 Spin your shot: backspin to stick, topspin to follow through
🎒 Marble Bags with every drop rate shown: Mythic 0.5%, Shiny 2%
🔁 Trade up: 5 marbles of one rarity make 1 of the next
📖 The Marble Book: finish sets for coins and numbered LIMITED marbles
🏆 Global leaderboard, badges, daily reward streak
👑 VIP: 2x coins, the Golden Taw and a VIP chat tag
⭐ Roblox Premium: free Prism marble and +25% coins

🕹️ Controls: press, pull back and let go. Spin pad or Q/E for spin. Phone, tablet and PC.

📜 Updates
31 Oct 2026: one-of-a-kind marbles with phenomena, trade-ups, the Marble Book, generated maps, the Mini-Golf course, spin.
28 Oct 2026: first release.

Like 👍 and favourite ⭐ for new marbles and fields every update!
